i=s.index("    out = np.empty(n - width + 1")
s=s[:i]+'''    prefix = np.zeros(n + 1, dtype=np.int64)
    np.cumsum(values, dtype=np.int64, out=prefix[1:])
    return prefix[width:] - prefix[: n - width + 1]
'''
s=s.replace("Runs in O(n) time with a running total.","Runs in O(n) time with a prefix sum.")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python -m pytest -q -m "not deliberately_flaky" 2>&1 | tail -3
git commit -qam "rolling_sum: use a vectorised prefix sum
